facts_observed.implication: Workspace-level time-entry listing is not a GET endpoint. Listing is via GET /workspaces/{workspaceId}/user/{userId}/time-entries or possibly POST-based search. Both specs incorrectly document GET /workspaces/{workspaceId}/time-entries as the list endpoint.

notes: GET /workspaces/{workspaceId}/time-entries (bare, no entry ID) returns 405. Confirmed NOT a valid GET list endpoint. Time entries listing requires userId in path: /workspaces/{workspaceId}/user/{userId}/time-entries.
